comparison.objective: Bag a circuit board and place the bag in a crate; candidate commissions and locks a shock absorber through repeated physical cycles.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-board insertion into a hand-stabilized cavity versus hex-key unlocking, collar tuning, relocking, and response-based adjustment.
comparison.success_condition: Board fully bagged, released, and crated versus two safe, repeatable damped stops plus lock-drift limits.
comparison.reason: Both use bimanual stabilization, but they test materially different insertion/packaging and mechanical commissioning abilities.
